Custom Tandem Bicycles | The Rodriguez Toucan
Read about our years of tandem building and tandem innovations.
Toucan ST - Fun for the whole family
The Toucan ST is an economical, low step through design that's easy to ride for adults or children. It's a family friendly tandem and comes equipped with tandem quality components all around and, of course, our 'comfortable fit' guarantee.
• Fit everyone - Optional Telescoping Seat Post(s)
• Perfect size - Every build is custom
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Enjoy the comfort of a light weight steel frame
• Anything else....Just ask!
Full bike from $6,500
See full specifications below - Start an order Family, Fun, Economical, Versatile
Paint Options. Decal Options:
With a Rodriguez, you can get a custom look for less. All Rodriguez bicycles come in your choice of 16 standard paint colors or for a few $$ extra you can choose from dozens of our snazzy colors in stock. We have four different styles of decals to choose from in . If you have a special paint design in mind, just let us know the design, and we'll quote it for you.
All Rodriguez Tandem bicycles are made custom to guarantee a comfortable fit.
Ordering:
To order a Rodriguez bicycle from outside the state of Washington, click here.
Our bikes are as unique as our customers... they love our bikes, and we love them!
Don't live nearby? You can still order a Rodriguez. Check our our FAQ page.
